name: [🎈UPDATE] Eat a Brainrot 🍔
desc:
🧠 Welcome to Eat a Brainrot!

🤯 added 10 new brainrots

👍 Like the game and join the group!

How to Play:
👾 Buy a Brainrot from the field
😋 Eat Brainrots to earn money
💪 Upgrade Bite Power, Bite Speed & Walk Speed
🔥 Rebirth to gain multipliers and progress faster
⚡ Unlock awesome boosts in the Boost Shop
🏆 Climb the Leaderboards and compete with other players!

💻 Supports PC, Mobile & Tablet players

🙏 Huge thanks to the community for all the support!
